reason: I already have an Instagram page I order from every month and they've always delivered, so why would I send money to a name I've never heard of? The written quote is nice, but my page works fine for me.
objection: Paying the item price up front to a brand new service with no reviews. If they disappear, my money is gone, and Taobao links are not something I know how to check myself.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing women I know, or a page with real customer videos and comments, get their orders delivered from them, or letting me pay everything on delivery for my first order.
